name: King EX65
description: King EX65 by The Disk King: Inspired by the Akai EX65D digital delay (1987). Delay time RANGE (2, 8, 32, 128, 512 ms) x MULTI (x0.5 to x2) = 1 to 1024 ms, FEED BACK, RATE and WIDTH modulation (chorus, flanger, doubling, tape wobble), DELAY LEVEL, HOLD (loops the echoes forever), INPUT light, EFFECT in/out with the echoes ringing out.
author: The Disk King
